svg.text: deham9: multi-AZ WordPress, dev / test / prod
min 5 / desired 5 / max 6, arm64, CPU + request scaling
off hours: 1 instance, 19:00-06:00 UTC and weekends
enable_nat_gateway = false: NAT is off, private subnets have no internet route
WordPress files, NFS :2049, /var/www/html, encrypted, TLS-only, backed up, mount target per AZ
ALB: CloudFront IPs + secret header only; web SG: 80 from ALB
SSH closed (SSM Session Manager); role deham9-dev-web-role
IMDSv2 required, encrypted EBS and EFS (TLS mount)
Aurora private+encrypted; WordPress DB user, not master
HTTPS at CloudFront; flow logs; logs TLS-only
10 alarms -> SNS: ALB, ASG, DB, EFS
